{{Quotation|game|The [[Shiverpeak Mountains|Shiverpeaks]] rise up over ten-thousand feet above sea level. In the shadow of this enormous mountain range lie the kingdoms of [[Kryta]] to the west and [[Ascalon]] to the east. Borlis Pass is the closest travelable passage through the mountains to the city of [[Rin]]. The next closest lies much farther north, deep in [[Charr]] territory.}}

[[Borlis Pass (outpost)|Borlis Pass]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]] and is one of the few passages to cross the Shiverpeak Mountains.

==Getting There==

*From [[Yak's Bend]] follow the road to the southwest.
*The quest [[The Way is Blocked]] will bring you here.

==Mission==
*[[Borlis Pass]]
**This mission is the fifth mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the first mission in the [[Northern Shiverpeaks]] region.
